dict.string: Read locally synced Mail and Notes to answer your questions, and send assistant replies to your verified Messages self-chat.
Read contacts to resolve message and meeting participants locally on this Mac.
Read calendar events to answer questions and maintain your local personal index.
Read reminders to answer your questions locally. The assistant does not modify reminders.
Search and read supported documents in folders you permit for your local assistant.
Search and read supported files in your permitted Desktop folder.
Search and read supported files in your permitted Downloads folder.
Read permitted photo and video metadata to answer your questions locally.
